<div class="dc-sheet-commentary"><div class="dc-sheet-rule"><h3>Sine, cosine and tangent</h3>
<p><span data-math="\frac{d}{dx}\sin f(x)=f^{\prime}(x)\cos f(x)"></span></p><p><span data-math="\frac{d}{dx}\cos f(x)=-f^{\prime}(x)\sin f(x)"></span></p><p><span data-math="\frac{d}{dx}\tan f(x)=f^{\prime}(x)\sec^2 f(x)"></span></p></div>
<p>The printed rules already include the chain rule.</p><p>The derivatives of $\sec x$, $\operatorname{cosec}x$ and $\cot x$ can be derived using reciprocal identities.</p><p class="dc-domain">Angles in radians.</p></div></div>
